name: "Moo Shu" Wraps with Egg, Mushroom, Cabbage & Green Onion
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl the bottom. Add eggs and scramble using a combination of stirring and folding, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until no longer runny; transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onion, ginger, and garlic powder; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add mushrooms, cabbage, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes more.
Return egg to the skillet, along with hoisin sauce, and stir to combine. Continue to cook the "moo shu" fillling until heated through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas and "moo shu" filling between plates. Serve with additional hoisin sauce on the side for dipping and enjoy!
author: Mealime
